Name: Bithiah
Summary: Daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took, named as mother of Mered's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took, named as mother of Mered's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bithiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
